{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= What Are Active Skills? ={outline}{color}{size} 
These are special skills that belong only to certain characters. 
They can be activated in battle at any time once 
certain conditions are met. 
The conditions required to activate Active Skills differ 
from skill to skill, as do their effects. 

You can check the activation conditions and the skill's effects 
from "Active Skill" found on the "Character Details" page. 
In general, Active Skills can be used once per battle.

{size: 25}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= What Is Transformation? ={outline}{color}{size} 
This is a Passive Skill that belongs to certain characters. 
It can only be activated in battle during the character's 
attacking turn when certain conditions are met. 
The conditions required to activate Transformation differ from 
skill to skill. Transformation can only be used once per battle. 
* Some characters can deactivate then reactivate 
their Transformation in the same battle. 
The Transformation will be deactivated automatically 
when a battle ends. 

You can check the activation conditions and 
the character's stats after Transformation by tapping 
the "Transformation Button" ("Fusion Button" in the image) 
found at the top of the "Character Details" page.

from a stage. 

{color : #FFFF00}Rewards that can be increased:{color} 
- Rewards obtainable from the map. 
- Rewards obtainable upon victory. 
- Rewards obtainable upon clearing a stage.

- First-drop rewards, including characters 
   (certain stages excluded).

the same kind.

{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= What Are Unit Super Attacks? ={outline}{color}{size} 
These are special Super Attacks that belong only to 
certain characters. They will be activated in battle 
once certain conditions are met. The activation of 
a Unit Super Attack that has a more powerful effect 
will be prioritized. If the effects are the same, the 
Unit Super Attack triggered by the ally furthest 
to the left will be prioritized.

When the activation conditions are met, an animation 
with a scene similar to the one shown below will be 
played. Please note that a character can only launch 
a Unit Super Attack once per turn.

{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= What Is the Revival Skill? ={outline}{color}{size} 
This is a special skill that belongs only to certain characters.

Certain characters can be exchanged for other characters. 
 
You can check the characters available for exchange by 
tapping the "+" button found at the top right of Baba's Shop 
and selecting "Characters for Characters". 
 
{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= Notes on Exchange ={color}{outline}{size} 
The character used to perform the exchange will be 
removed from your "Character List", and the character 
recruited via exchange will be in their initial state. 
 
The recruited character's Awakening state, equipped 
Skill Orbs and applied visual effects will all be reset. 
You will have to develop the character's Super Attack level, 
Link Skill levels, Hidden Potential, etc. from scratch. 
 
* The number of Coins obtainable through exchange and 
Tags will remain the same. 
 
Also, once the exchange is performed, the character cannot 
be reversed back to their original state. 
 
{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= Unlock Hidden Potential Routes ={color}{outline}{size} 
When unlocking Hidden Potential routes, characters that 
can be recruited via exchange and used to unlock routes 
will be displayed in the list. You can go and perform the 
exchange from here. 
 
{size: 24}{outline: #FF0000, 2}{color: #FFFF00}= Character Growth Menu ={color}{outline}{size} 
A "Character Exchange" button will be displayed in the menu 
accessed via "Character Details -> Growth" for both the 
character to be exchanged and the character to be recruited, 
allowing you to perform the exchange from there as well.

To engage in a battle, deploy any number of 
your Sticker Cards to confront an enemy 
Sticker Card that appears on the battlefield. 

You do not need to defeat the enemy in one go. 
If a battle ends before you win, the enemy's status 
will be carried over into your next attempt. 

Battles can be continued at a later time as follows: 
- If you retire from a battle you have started. 
- If you lose a battle.

by tapping the "Battle Ended" button. If you lose, enemies 
will remain in the state they were in from the last battle.

in mind before engaging in a battle. Enemy HP, 
the sum of each enemy Sticker Card's HP, 
will be displayed on the bar located at the top.
